comments.body:
🔴 **CRITICAL:** The fenced bash block reads as an inert example, but the SKILL.md parser executes the exclamation-mark-backtick pattern even inside fenced code blocks (GitHub #12781) — and even when escaped. So `!`git status`` is not documentation; it is arbitrary code that runs the moment this skill is loaded, with no deliberate user action. This repo's own `skill-development.md` rule calls out exactly this pattern as something to never ship. Use the house `$ command` notation so the block stays inert:

```suggestion
$ git status
```
